source_document: NBA.com game summary pages (LINESCORES + GAME INFO blocks) and the 2026-11-14 scoreboard
source_document_header: Scoreboard page prints the date filter 'Sat, Nov 14' with no other table heading; each game-summary page prints the heading LINESCORES above the quarter table that supplied Q1-Q4
row_format_note: row_format lists the positional columns of each row in `rows`.

verification.quarter_sum_rule: For every row the four printed quarter scores were added and compared with the printed Final. 10 of 10 team lines agree, so every row is SETTLEMENT_ELIGIBLE.
verification.final_score_cross_check: Each Final equals the number printed on the 2026-11-14 scoreboard page and, for four of the five games, in the headline of the Associated Press recap printed on the same official page (116-108, 127-117, 137-117, 117-106). CHI 117 at MIN 106 is confirmed by the recap headline 'Bulls ... beat the Timberwolves 117-106'.
verification.home_away_basis: The page prints the line-score row order away-then-home and the URL slug uses 'away-vs-home'; this matches the schedule PDF printed order for the same rows (rows 231-235).

extraction_notes: This is one dated observation of a completed game day, not a live feed. The scoreboard and game pages change; the values above are those printed at the fetch time recorded here.
Officials and attendance were printed on the same pages (e.g. 0022600231: James Capers, Brent Barnaky, CJ Washington; attendance 15,721) and are not republished in the site table.
No spread, total, probability, price or pick is present in this file. Nothing here is a settlement decision on any project forecast; the ledger settlement step reads this file.
